# ankra_service_packages (Data Source)

Lists the service package versions the organisation can set a managed service up from: its own, those shared with it, and first-party ones. Use an `id` as `package_version_id` on `ankra_managed_service`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_service_packages" "all" {}

output "first_party_packages" {
  value = [for package in data.ankra_service_packages.all.packages : "${package.name}@${package.version}" if package.first_party]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `packages` (Attributes List) Package versions, in the platform's order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))

<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packages`

Read-Only:

- `capability` (String) What the package provides, such as a database engine.
- `created_at` (String) When the version was published.
- `digest` (String) Content digest of the version.
- `first_party` (Boolean) Whether Ankra publishes it.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the package version.
- `name` (String) Package name.
- `publisher_id` (String) Organisation that published it.
- `version` (String) Version.
